cases.sentence: ___ не больше своего господина, и посланный не больше пославшего его.
cases.explain: Слуга is the grammatical subject of the sentence, so it is nominative.

cases.sentence: Слуга не больше своего ___, и посланный не больше пославшего его.
cases.explain: The comparative construction не больше (not greater) governs the genitive of comparison.

cases.sentence: Когда он подошел к Симону ___, тот сказал ему, «Господи, тебе ли мыть мне ноги?»
cases.explain: The preposition к governs the dative case.

cases.sentence: Потом он налил воды в ___ и начал мыть своим ученикам ноги.
cases.explain: The preposition в indicating motion into a container takes the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Иисус... снял с себя верхнюю одежду и опоясался ___.
cases.explain: The verb опоясаться (to gird oneself) governs the instrumental case of the means used.

cases.sentence: Иисус снова оделся и, возвратившись, возлег на своем ___ за столом.
cases.explain: The preposition на indicating location takes the prepositional case.

reading.ru: Иисус, зная, что отец отдал все в руки его, и что он пришел от Бога, и теперь возвращается к Богу, встал из-за стола, снял с себя верхнюю одежду и опоясался полотенцем.
reading.question: What did Jesus do before washing the disciples' feet?
options: He got up from the table, removed his outer clothing, and wrapped a towel around himself
He prayed silently for an hour
He sent all the disciples away first
reading.correct: He got up from the table, removed his outer clothing, and wrapped a towel around himself
reading.explain: Jesus rose from supper, took off his outer garment, and wrapped a towel around himself.

reading.ru: «Ты никогда не вымоешь моих ног», — возразил Петр.
reading.question: What did Peter initially say about Jesus washing his feet?
options: That Jesus would never wash his feet
That he would wash Jesus's feet instead
That only a priest should wash feet
That it was unnecessary since he was already clean
reading.correct: That Jesus would never wash his feet
reading.explain: Peter protested, 'You shall never wash my feet.'

reading.ru: «Если я не омою тебя, то у тебя нет со мной ничего общего».
reading.question: What did Jesus say would happen if he did not wash Peter?
options: Peter would have no part with him
Peter would be expelled from the group
Peter would have to leave at once
Peter would lose all his faith
reading.correct: Peter would have no part with him
reading.explain: Jesus said, 'If I do not wash you, you have no part with me.'

reading.ru: «Вот вы называете меня Учителем и Господом, и правильно, потому что я и есть Учитель и Господь.
reading.question: What titles did the disciples correctly call Jesus?
reading.explain: Jesus says they call him Teacher and Lord, and rightly so.

reading.ru: Но слова Писания «Тот, кто ест мой хлеб, поднял свою пяту против меня» должны исполниться.
reading.question: What Scripture did Jesus say must be fulfilled regarding his betrayer?
options: He who eats my bread has lifted up his heel against me
A prophet is not honored in his hometown
The stone the builders rejected has become the cornerstone
Out of Egypt I called my son
reading.correct: He who eats my bread has lifted up his heel against me
reading.explain: Jesus quotes the Scripture that whoever eats his bread has lifted his heel against him.

reading.ru: «Говорю вам истину, один из вас предаст меня».
reading.question: What troubling statement did Jesus make to his disciples during supper?
options: That one of them would betray him
That one of them would die that night
That they would all abandon their homes
reading.correct: That one of them would betray him
reading.explain: Jesus said, 'Truly, truly, I say to you, one of you will betray me.'

reading.ru: И обмакнув кусок, Иисус протянул его Иуде Искариоту, сыну Симона.
reading.question: To whom did Jesus give the dipped piece of bread?
reading.explain: Jesus dipped the piece of bread and gave it to Judas Iscariot, son of Simon.

reading.ru: Как только Иуда взял хлеб, в него вошел сатана.
reading.question: What happened immediately after Judas took the bread?
reading.explain: As soon as Judas took the bread, Satan entered into him.

reading.ru: Я даю вам новую заповедь. Любите друг друга. Как я вас полюбил, так и вы любите друг друга.
reading.question: What new commandment did Jesus give his disciples?
options: To love one another as he had loved them
reading.correct: To love one another as he had loved them
reading.explain: Jesus gave a new commandment: to love one another as he had loved them.

reading.ru: Говорю тебе истину, не успеет сегодня и петух пропеть, как ты трижды отречешься от меня.
reading.question: What did Jesus predict about Peter?
options: That Peter would deny him three times before the rooster crowed
That Peter would become the first pope
That Peter would betray him for money
That Peter would die that same night
reading.correct: That Peter would deny him three times before the rooster crowed
reading.explain: Jesus told Peter that before the rooster crowed, he would deny him three times.
